problems.title: First number
problems.statement: A recruiter asks for your salary expectations in the first call.

options: defer politely until there's an offer, or give a well-researched range
name a low number to seem reasonable
one specific counter with a reason, then decide

problems.title: Exploding offer
problems.statement: A 48-hour deadline while another process is two weeks away.

options: ask the other company to accelerate

problems.solution: Never invent offers or renege; industries are small.

problems.title: Equity
problems.statement: A $200k four-year grant at a private company valued on its last round.
problems.solution: $50k/year on paper; discount it for risk and illiquidity.

problems.title: Level

options: level sets the whole band and future growth

problems.solution: A level change outweighs a one-off bump.

problems.title: Trading bonus

options: how bonuses are determined, and the historical range for this role

hints: Variable comp dominates at trading firms.
problems.solution: Ask about the mechanics and history; first-year guarantees are sometimes available.

problems.title: Decision
problems.statement: Two offers: A pays 15% more; B has the team and work you want most.

options: weigh the long-term trajectory (learning, team, career) and the total expected value, not just first-year comp

problems.solution: Skills compound; so does a good team.
